title: To direct the Secretary of Veterans Affairs to submit to Congress a report on the use of cameras in medical facilities of the Department of Veterans Affairs.
official_summary: This bill requires the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) to report on its policies and procedures relating to the usage and maintenance of video cameras for patient safety and law enforcement at VA medical facilities.

summary.headline: This law requires the Department of Veterans Affairs to report to Congress on how it uses and maintains video cameras at its medical facilities.
summary.what_it_does: The law orders the VA to send Congress a report on its policies and procedures for video cameras at VA medical facilities. The cameras are used for patient safety and law enforcement. The law requires a report but does not itself set new camera rules.

who_it_affects.group: Veterans who receive care at VA medical facilities
who_it_affects.how: The report may lead to later changes in how cameras are used for patient safety, but the law itself does not change their care or rights.

who_it_affects.group: VA employees and law enforcement staff at VA medical facilities
who_it_affects.how: They must help the VA gather the information needed for the report on camera policies and procedures.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: Upon enactment on November 23, 2021, though the law does not state a specific deadline for the report in the summary provided.
